summary: @cacheable/node-cache 3.1.2 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares preinstall `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is heavily obfuscated with an RC4/base64 string-array decoder and, on `npm install`, downloads a Bun runtime archive from GitHub releases matching the detected platform (linux/darwin/win32 × x64/arm64, including musl-baseline), extracts it (unzip on POSIX; PowerShell Expand-Archive with `-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` on Windows), chmods the binary +x, and invokes it against a 727KB obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle shipped in the tarball as `Math_Symbol.js`. The advertised package purpose (an in-memory cache library) does not require a Bun runtime, the payload file is not referenced from dist/exports, and its contents are unreadable to Node-based inspection because they only execute under the Bun runtime fetched at install time. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern executes attacker-controlled code on every installer's machine during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
